reviews.t: Same bottle as my salon-Not the same shampoo inside!!!
reviews.x: After receiving, I opened the lid to see if the product looked and smelled the same as my salon bottle to make sure it's the same quality. It was NOT!!! The shampoo purchased from this seller is thicker, more opaque and doesn't smell as good as the version I bought at the salon.  It makes me wonder if someone is selling the advertised product mixed with a cheaper shampoo of less quality hoping no one would notice but I DID!

This is luxury in a bottle if your hair is "mature" (i.e., gray) and colored.  The smell is wonderful, too.  I've had a lot of problems with my hair being heat-damaged, but this shampoo and conditioner really do improve the coarse, dry texture.  I highly recommend this duo for anyone with problem hair.

Buy this shampoo. It is worth every penny!!! I have fine oily hair that I felt needed to be washed daily, sometimes even more frequently. I have tried every shampoo out there...I think, and finally here is one that allows me to wash my hair less frequently.  After about three weeks of use every other day or so, I notice my hair feels smoother and softer and looks healthier, I'm not kidding this is possible. Oh yea and I use very little product as a small amount goes a long way. Not only do I spe

reviews.t: super happy to have found this
reviews.x: I used to like the old purology but I like this much better.  I was in a rut, complaining to my hair dresser that I could no longer make my hair smooth and healthy looking.  After 2-3 months with this combination I am happy with my hair again.  And, i can easily go a few days between washes which used to be hard for me. My hair:  42, mostly gray, colored every 3.5 weeks and in the sun a lot!

I love this shampoo.  It smells great and really leaves my hair feeling clean and soft without a ton of build-up.  The conditioner that goes with this stuff is great as well and helps keep the frizz down.

The shampoo smells amazing. That’s probably the only good thing about it. It somehow left my roots oily but the ends of my hair became more and more dry after each use. I really don’t understand how there could be so many positive reviews. My fiancé also had the same issue as me and we were using it with the conditioner.

Tried countless of other brands (Fekkai, Pureology, Enjoy, It's A 10)and this is the best of the best:  Leaves hair with a refreshing & cooling tingle. Moisturizes without weighing down my thin hair. A dime size drop goes a long way with this product.  The price initially set me off...but I have never been happier with a product so I guess you get what you pay for.

reviews.t: Must have for dry haired blondes!
reviews.x: This is an amazing, let me say again, an amazing shampoo.  My hair is ultra dry from coloring.  Just a small amount foams up like crazy.  It smells great, cleans and re-moisturizer at the same time.  It is expensive, but you need to use so little that it lasts a long time.
Lathers beautifully and a little goes a very long way.  Leaves my thin fine hair feeling shiny and smooth.  My hair is not color treated but is very fragile.

My hair stylist first game me a sample (travel) sized bottle of the Shampoo & Conditioner of this product.  Not only do I absolutely love the smell, I can tell a difference in the softness of my hair (and the preservation of my color) as compared to the traditional brands you may buy in a big box store.  This delivery was timely & very neatly packaged from the seller & I would absolutely order other products through their site.

This shampoo smells fabulous and leaves my hair super clean, soft, and supple.  I can now go an extra day without shampooing since I've started using this shampoo - really cleans without stripping the hair and making it dry.  This is the best shampoo I've ever used - doesn't affect the color at all.

LOVE THIS SHAMPOO!! It is concentrated so you need very very little. I have long thick hair and I only use about the size of a nickle to wash my hair so this bottle will last me about 3 to 4 months.  A regular bottle of shampoo will only last me 3 or 4 weeks, plus it makes my hair frizzy. This shampoo (along with the conditioner which is mint scented) will leave your hair silky, smooth and smelling great! It also helps hold the color in my hair much longer than other products which is great!  I

reviews.t: DON’T waste your money on products that are not certified ColorProof
reviews.x: THIS IS ILLEGAL to sell ColorProof over the internet. SHAME ON Amazon for allowing this to happen!!! Only licensed hairstylists are allowed to sell these from their salons. I know for a FACT that these products that are purchased over the internet are NOT THE REAL THING….they are either a diluted version or cheap shampoo poured into the bottle. ColorProof has an anti-diversion program that they take very seriously to uphold the integrity of their products. This is dangerous to purchasers not kno

DO NOT BUY THIS!!!!!! It is not the correct stuff. They are filling it with a totally different conditioner than color proof. The smell, color, and consistency are all different. I was so disappointed! THEN, when going to return it, I still had to pay for return shipping and that alone was half the cost of the product! I am so mad and upset. Learn from my mistakes, DO NOT BUY FROM THEM.

This shampoo is wonderful for my dry greying hair.  I wasn't prepared for the effects of age would have on my hair!  This shampoo was recommended and it has not disappointed!  I've used many high end shampoos/conditioners and this is one of the best I've tried.  My hair feels clean, but not stripped.
This shampoo somehow made my scalp itchy while leaving my hair oily. I would have never imagined that was possible.

I started coloring my hair and my hair got dry...something I had never dealt with in all my 50 plus years of living.  I tried other shampoos and ended up with rashes, hair that was still dry, or it weighed my fine hair down.  This shampoo works really well at adding moisture back into my hair without weighing it down.  A little shampoo goes a long way so, be careful that you do not use too much out of habit.

Curious how this seller has gotten around the Non diversion contract either they or the person that sold it to them had to sign. This is a diverted product and therefor NOT guaranteed by ColorProof. Guaranteed ONLY when sold in and by a licensed hairdresser/ salon.

reviews.t: the best moisturizing shampoo out there
reviews.x: I have tried numerous moisturizing and reconstructing shampoos for my dry, color-treated, wavy hair that I blow dry and flat iron.  This is the best out there.  It leaves my hair soft and shiny.

reviews.t: Ordered this because it is gluten-free my hairdresser told me ...
reviews.x: Ordered this because it is gluten-free my hairdresser told me.  It makes your hair extremely soft ... I also use the conditioner.  But, if it helps my scalp, I'm all for it.
love this brand.  only use a small amount each time, as it lathers well.  bottle lasts a long time, altho still wish it wasn't so expensive!
I love, love, love this shampoo.  It makes my hair soft without weighing it down.  It goes a long way, just a little bit will do.
Not for me.  Didn’t like the smell.  I like my shampoos to smell good.

I love this shampoo and conditioner but the price is a bit steep for my wallet. My hair is dry and color-treated and this product did wonders for my hair but I can't continue paying the high cost for the small bottles. Buy it if you can afford it because it's great. I had to purchase this shampoo and conditioner every other week, and that was even with me using a very small amount per wash. Too bad!

reviews.t: This is simply the best shampoo ever
reviews.x: Crack for your hair!!! This is simply the best shampoo ever. You will notice an extreme change in the texture of your hair after 2-3 weeks of use. It also has the added benefit that it doesn't take much to get the job done. Like I have said before, the only down side of this product is that it is pricey. It is not to share with the kids or your hubby!!!

claims.text: Most reviewers love this shampoo, praising its pleasant scent and how clean, soft, and manageable it leaves their hair.
Many reviewers say a small amount goes a long way and that it lets them go longer between washes.
Several reviewers with dry, colored, or mature/gray hair report it improves texture and preserves color.
A few reviewers suspect the product is not genuine, citing different smell, color, or consistency than salon versions.
One reviewer reports oily roots and increasingly dry ends, an issue shared by their partner.
